issues.description: Inconsistent return type for Lecture.getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): the problem statement/UML specifies it returns int, but the template comment explicitly hints a double return type for precision and the reference solution implements the method as double. This can mislead students into implementing the wrong method signature and failing signature-based tests or UML-based expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across all artifacts: either update the UML/problem statement to getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double (matching the solution and template hint), or change the template hint and solution implementation to return int and explicitly define rounding/truncation behavior.
